subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: Should this issue stay evidence-first, be folded into the unknown-pricing contract, or be narrowed to the vLLM token/Usage-page path?
rationale: Current source has a vLLM streaming-usage path, but the report does not prove whether tokens are missing, only costs are missing, or the Usage page is filtering/aggregating incorrectly; choosing a local pricing behavior also overlaps an open maintainer policy issue.

options.title: Keep Evidence-First
options.body: Ask for raw vLLM stream, matching transcript usage, `sessions.usage`, `usage.cost`, screenshot, and model cost config before opening a fix PR.

options.title: Fold Cost Into Pricing Contract
options.body: Treat cost calculation for unpriced vLLM models as owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674 and keep this issue only for token/blank-page evidence.

options.title: Narrow To vLLM Token Path
options.body: If new evidence shows tokens are zero despite vLLM final usage chunks, handle it alongside the OpenAI-compatible streaming-usage compatibility work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96463.

recommendation.title: Keep Evidence-First
recommendation.body: Ask for raw vLLM stream, matching transcript usage, `sessions.usage`, `usage.cost`, screenshot, and model cost config before opening a fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across current usage-cost source, vLLM metadata in the current snapshot, and pricing-policy-adjacent changes.
